text: {"lessons":["Selling winners felt rewarding, but realizing a gain is not by itself evidence that selling was the best choice; I should decide based on a consistent plan.","My account value stayed unchanged for several periods after I stopped trading, reminding me that inactivity can be reasonable when there is no clear reason to act.","Frequent checking can encourage unnecessary trades, so I should focus on long-term goals rather than reacting to every monthly review."]}
